variants.headline: Illness spreads beyond the clinics' reach
variants.body: Illness is spreading, with {sick} people too ill to work and {district} worst affected. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.

variants.headline: Pandemic leaves {sick} too ill to work
variants.body: The pandemic has left {sick} people unable to work; {district} is the worst affected district. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.

variants.headline: {district} bears the worst of the pandemic
variants.body: The worst affected district is {district}, while illness leaves {sick} people unable to work. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.
